scenes.title: Two tides a day
scenes.purpose: Establish the subject and the world: the Moon crossing the shared night sky above Earth, with the claim in the heading.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: The Moon gliding along its orbit and the heading TWO TIDES A DAY by 1.5 s.
scenes.focalPoint: Earth with orbit ellipse, right of centre; heading upper-left
scenes.heroObject: Earth sphere with orbit path and a travelling Moon
scenes.heroMove: Moon travels along the orbit path
scenes.motionWhy: The Moon's travel is the cause the whole film explains.

transitionOut.motivation: The cloud bank carries us from the overview to the cause.

scenes.first2s: Frame 0: the gold TWO already on the teal-navy night sky with the HUD title, Earth and the dotted orbit ellipse; TIDES and A DAY rise in by 0.5 s and the Moon starts along its orbit at 0.4 s.

scenes.title: Two bulges
scenes.purpose: Explain the cause: show the near-side and far-side water bulges around Earth, which the hook only asserted.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: Two bulges on opposite sides of Earth, each labelled, by 4 s.
scenes.focalPoint: Earth with ocean ellipse in a tilted 3D stage, centre-left
text: Water is pulled toward the Moon
scenes.heroObject: CSS-3D Earth with ocean bulge and moon, two callouts
scenes.heroMove: Ocean ellipse swells around Earth while the 3D camera sways
scenes.motionWhy: The swell is the claim: water piles up on both sides.

transitionOut.motivation: From the static picture to Earth in motion.

scenes.title: One spin, two highs
scenes.purpose: Make it personal: a place on the coast rides Earth through both bulges in one lunar day, so two high tides follow.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: The pin passing the near and far bulges and HIGH TIDE chips lighting at both.
scenes.focalPoint: Top-down Earth with a pin on its rim, centre; elapsed-hours panel right
scenes.heroObject: Top-down Earth with fixed bulge, pin path and chips
scenes.heroMove: Pin rides the rim once while the elapsed-hours counter runs
scenes.motionWhy: The pin keeps the same object from scene 2 and moves it through time.

transitionOut.motivation: From a day's cycle to the single interval inside it.

scenes.title: 12.4 hours
scenes.purpose: Convert the ride into the number the viewer keeps: the interval between two high tides.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: The gauge needle landing on 12.4 h and the curve's second peak marked.
scenes.heroObject: Dial gauge plus tide curve with a travelling marker
scenes.heroMove: Gauge needle sweeps to 12.4 h while a marker rides the tide curve
scenes.motionWhy: The needle's sweep and the marker's ride land on the same number.

transitionOut.motivation: Back from data to the closing statement.

scenes.title: The Moon sets the clock
scenes.purpose: Compress the film into three cards and one repeatable line.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: MOON in gold in the closing line, after the three cards.
scenes.focalPoint: Three cards in a row, headline beneath
scenes.heroMove: Cards flip in from a 3D angle, then the headline reveals
scenes.motionWhy: A staggered 3D entrance sets the beat of a three-part summary.
